title: Freeze ProgressBar timer using task.finished_time on completion
answers: Why does the timer on a finished ProgressBar keep running in meta-estimators?
How to stop ProgressBar timers from ticking after a task completes?
Why does task.elapsed keep increasing for finished tasks in ProgressBar?
body:
Symptom: When using ProgressBar with max_propagation_depth > 0 in meta-estimators, timers on finished progress bars continue running while subsequent bars are filling up.
Root cause: sklearn/callback/_progressbar.py:render used task.elapsed instead of task.finished_time for finished tasks.
Fix pattern: Use task.finished_time rather than task.elapsed to freeze elapsed timers on completed tasks.
Constraints: Applies when task.finished and elapsed_when_finished are True; does not apply to active tasks or time_remaining displays.
